fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User-provided description of the endpoint group.

fields.label: Intercept Deployment Group
fields.help: The deployment group that this endpoint group is connected to, for example: 'projects/123456789/locations/global/interceptDeploymentGroups/my-dg'.

fields.label: Intercept Endpoint Group ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the endpoint group, which will become the final component of the endpoint group's resource name.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The cloud location of the endpoint group, currently restricted to 'global'.
